description: This file handles the change password functionality within the SuiteCRM user management system. It processes form submissions for updating user passwords, performs validation, loads templates, and manages redirections related to password change workflows.

classes.name: Configurator
classes.description: A class instance used to manage system configuration settings.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine instance used for rendering the Change Password form and UI components.

classes.name: SuiteValidator
classes.description: A utility class used to validate user IDs during password change process.

methods.name: change_password
methods.description: Method of the User object to change the user's password, given the old and new password.
